{{Quote|Green Company: prepare to repel the enemy!|Commander Gree|<ref name="Cloak" />}}
'''Green Company''' was the name of a [[Company/Legends|company]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], a part of the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]]. The unit was responsible for the reclamation of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], and the defence of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyer]], ''[[Tranquility/Legends|Tranquility]].

==History==
===Battle on Rishi===
[[File:Cooker.jpg|thumb|left|180px|"Cooker", one of the best sharpshooters in Green Company]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], trying to obtain the [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]] needed for their [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic weapons]], an army of [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] led [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], a part of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], invaded the planet of Rishi. Hearing of this invasion, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] dispatched members of the Green Company, alongside [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], to stop the Separatists.<ref name="Gauntlet" />

While awaiting [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] Kit Fisto's arrival, Green Company was forced to attack the Geonosian controlled mines by their leader, [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] [[Gwarrk]]. This attack caused the company to suffer a large amount of casualties. On the verge of defeat, General Kit Fisto arrived on the battlefield. With the help of clone trooper [[Cooker|2242]], nicknamed "Cooker", Kit Fisto and Green Company managed to defeat the CIS, and return Rishi to its rightfull [[Rishii/Legends|owners]].<ref name="Gauntlet" />

===Skirmish on the ''Tranquility''===
[[File:Skirmish_on_the_Tranquility.png|thumb|left|250px|Members of Green Company defend the ''Tranquility'' from attack.]]
After [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was betrayed and nearly captured on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]] came to her aid, after they had received a plea for help by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. The 41st secured the captured [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], and took him to the ''Tranquility'', where he was imprisoned.<ref name="Bombad Jedi">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}}</ref>

Twenty one clone troopers from the Green Company, under the command of [[Green Leader (clone trooper)/Legends|Green Leader]], were present on the ''Tranquility'', when it was [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|attacked]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] and [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|boarding craft]].<ref name="Cloak" />

[[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] sent Green Company to eliminate the Separatist boarding party. Most of the company was killed by [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]]. The B2's shot missiles on positions where more troopers where killing them quickly. Green Leader sent a message to his Commander, but was exterminated moments after by an advancing super battle droid. One of the [[Unidentified Green Company trooper/Legends|last members]] of Green Company tried to get a message to the crew members, but was swiftly cut down by the Separatist assassin [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. Only six clones successfully retreated to the detention level. Three of the six were killed in a brave attempt to stop the droids when they advanced on the level. Finally, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], and Commander Gree, reinforced the three survivors and stopped the super battle droid rescue party. However, Gunray was successful in escaping, and as Ventress made her way to the ship Gunray was on, she killed two more Green Company troopers, before escaping.<ref name="Cloak" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:GreenCompanyConcept.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Concept art of the Green Company, from Cloak of Darkness]]
The Green Company was originally created by [[Paul Dini]] and [[Dave Filoni]] for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' TV series, where it appeared in the ninth episode of the first season, "[[Cloak of Darkness]]".<ref name="Cloak" /> The company also appeared in the flash back sequence of the tenth episode, "[[Lair of Grievous]]."<ref name="LoG">{{TCW|Lair of Grievous}}</ref> Green Company's last appearance was in the [[Dark Horse Comics]] story, "[[The Gauntlet of Death|The Clone Wars: The Gauntlet of Death]]," where they assisted Jedi Master Kit Fisto on Rishi.<ref name="Gauntlet" /> On the cardback of a [[2009]] Commander Gree action figure, it is stated that the Green Company was the nickname given by the commander to his 41st Elite Corps. This might be a mistake; however, as a [[Company/Legends|company]] and a [[Corps/Legends|corps]] cannot be the same by definition.<ref name="CW Toy">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2009 Basic Figure|pack=#09: Commander Gree|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW09_Gree.asp}}</ref>
